newsitem.title: SPAIN: BASKETBALL-YUGOSLAVIA BEAT GREECE TO REACH EUROPEAN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-YUGOSLAVIA BEAT GREECE TO REACH EUROPEAN FINAL.

text.p: Yugoslavia booked a berth in the European basketball championship final after handing Greece their first defeat of the tournament on Saturday.
The holders hit their best form in the 88-80 win and will now meet either Italy or Russia, who were due to play their semi-final later on Saturday.
Yugoslavia will start Sunday's final as favourites, even if their opponents are Italy, the only side to have beaten them so far in the competition.
Zeljko Obradovic's side went in at the break only four points up, but quickly took control and surged to a 65-50 lead.
The Greeks closed to 74-68, and with five opponents in foul trouble looked likely to give the reigning champions a close run.
But poor shot selection cost the Greeks the chance to draw closer and the Yugoslavs kept their heads to run out comfortable winners.
However two of Obradovic's key players are doubtful for Sunday's game.
Aleksandar Djordjevic did not start the match and was troubled by a leg injury throughout the game, particularly in the final time-out.
The injury may limit Djordjevic's role in the final, while fellow guard Predrag Danilovic pulled up at the end of the semifinal with an ankle injury.
All four semifinalists have already guaranteed places in next year's world championships.
